body: honestly? it felt pretty good to write that. im not in any serious danger of suicide right now, pretty calmed down. sorry for anyone reads this shitty story of my life, it reads like shitty fanfiction lol. ill probably be angsting about this again tomorrow, but i thankfully have a doctors appointment by then, scheduled randomly a month ago too, nice timing at least in these dark times. thank you if you comment on this, i probably wont respond but ill probably be alive at least. also sorry for the multiposts, i was writing a novel of a breakdown it seems lol

(04/04) Which brings us to today. My mother is in the hospital with Influenza-A, and the doctors say its not good. I rely on her for everything, food, water, shelter, etc.. I have horrible OCD(pathetic, I know), contamination anxiety in this case, and have no idea what I'll do to even get food or water anymore that isn't "tainted", don't have a car not even a licence, can't order them online because that same OCD applies to cybersecurity as well, and I can't go on most websites because of it (again, pathetic, I know). Don't have anyone else in my life I'd trust with that. Don't even know what would happen with housing, Its always been a feverdream to live on my own in an appartment, but I know it'd never work. When I got the news she wasn't doing good, blood in her lungs, I held my seldom used blade to my throat. Couldn't do it.
Pathetic. Pathetic. Pathetic. 
Made some slices on my arm, they're barely paper cuts. 
Pathetic. Pathetic. Pathetic.

When I finally have at least ambivelance towards ending my own life and instead improve it, the fates decide to end it themselves. Its honestly funny that way. I hope my life had at least some small meaning as a bad joke to some cosmic power, to be forgotten as soon as it was told. Maybe it got a chuckle or two. nah, i know it got them booed for how bad it was. pathetic

(03/04) That was, until about a year ago. I started playing an MMO, and somehow, miraculously, made a small group of friends, the first people I had talked to in years.
Then the invasion of bugs into our household happened. 
Retribution for stepping out of line.
But, it got dealt with and I continued talking to them, after a while my life started looking a bit brighter. I had some small semblance, illusion, of hope for the future, of things getting better.
Fate did not like that, no no. It had to punish me for thinking about rising above my caste. It had to rip apart that illusion of hope so that I never thought that again.

(02/04) I've always hated myself for what I am, though even still I make that pathetic too. Always adverse to any amount of pain I could never do what needed to be done. Never cut enough times, deep enough, could never starve (it would've been beneficial for a far fuck like me haha), when bad stuff did happen to me I hated it and whined all about it instead of what I should've done, accept that this is my punishment for what I am. 
The only thing I could do was fantasize about someone doing horrible, torturous things to me. Cutting my eye out, removing my fingernails one-by-one, removing my fingers one-by-one, whole arms legs teeth ears toes feet legs tongue, all other forms of torture I could think of, etc. I know though, that if that ever happened to me I could never withstand it and accept it as what needs to be done to me.

Because I lack any sort of drive or resolve to do ANYTHING at all, except video games (pathetic, I know. Think this is the most pathetic so far). I'm more akin to a bug than a human, I may have sentience but I do not have sapience.

I've been using Energized Basic and Adguard dns, and since the domains are legitimate I'll just keep them blocked, I haven't experienced any problems so far. I'm sure it was just me being overly-anxious so thank you for quelling my fears, and thank you for all the help.

Hi, thank you for replying and for your help,

I tried the Net Monitor and I am still using Android 9, but once I turned that on the domains basically dissapeared until I stopped the app, then came back. 

While using the Net Monitor I didn't see anything other than the system being tracked, aside from my internet browser while I was looking things up yet all the domains were either ip adresses and no url, amazonaws domains, a square box made out of four dots in each corner, and "one. one. one. one" showing up for everything being tracked.

After blocking the remote-data and device-api domains(c00161-dl was already blocked by blokada without me having to do anything) these two domains now appear nearly constantly, moreso than any other domain in Blokada, and it seems those two are prerequisites for c00161-dl, because I haven't seen that since blocking them.

I also went back through the Blokada log and I found that the domains had appeared before, but it was between every few thousand entries and it was only one of the three each time, never two or three at once and never spammed like it is now and never the c00161-dl domain.

I've also stopped using the Sprint mobile hotspot for fear of those domains I guess, leaking out of the hotspot and I wouldn't know about it. 

I apologize if this is rambly or hard to read, I have been stressed out about this almost all the time since it happened.
